reason: Cafés and brands already slide into my DMs with barter offers, and I barely have time to edit reels after my day job, let alone browse another app. I might connect it during the free month out of curiosity, but I don't see myself paying when the deals find me anyway.
objection: Why pay ₹499 a year for collabs when barter deals come to my DMs for free? And it's a beta from a small team, so I'm not sure enough good local brands will actually be on it.
would_change_my_mind: If my free first collab through Mitra turned into actual cash, not just a free meal, because the café's customer count showed I bring people in.
